saw_lines: Nobody buys a sofa on impulse. Buyers compare delivery times, fabric and returns across tabs before they pay.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the buyer decides whether the ad answers their question.
Your site offers 10% off, but only 1 of 18 ads mention it. Open three new ads with that offer on the Lighting range.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off, yet only 1 of 18 ads mention it, so new buyers see no reason to act today. Open three new ads with 10% off on the Lighting range, and print the offer on the creative itself.

None of your 29 ads mention shipping or delivery, though your site has a shipping policy page. Buyers of furniture need to know how it arrives before they click. Open new buyer ads with the delivery answer, not another style line.
None of your 29 ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Pick one number you can stand behind, such as a review count, and open three new ads with it.
2 of 18 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so the most personal format you run reads like a brand ad. Whitelist those two posts from the creator account and cut three room variations.

ads_1: Offer-led creative for Lighting, with the 10% off in line one
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
